excerpt.zh: [From.System.GetName]星系中有什么东西在损坏我们的探测器数据。这一异常现象的原因似乎是[From.GetName]星球。
excerpt.en: Something in the [From.System.GetName] system is corrupting some of our sensory data. The source of the irregularity seems to be the planet [From.GetName].

texts.zh: [From.System.GetName]星系中有什么东西在损坏我们的探测器数据。这一异常现象的原因似乎是[From.GetName]星球。
texts.en: Something in the [From.System.GetName] system is corrupting some of our sensory data. The source of the irregularity seems to be the planet [From.GetName].

texts.zh: [From.GetName] 根本不是颗星球，而是个复杂的三维投影。它的中央是一个投影仪，生成一片能源场来逼真地模拟星球的实体与重力井，连我们的传感器都误以为它真的是颗星球，因此产生了异常的数据。我们只能猜测为何有人会特意在这个位置模拟一颗星球的存在。可惜的是，该投影仪在我们对它进行实验时被毁了。
texts.en: [From.GetName] is not a planet at all, but a sophisticated 3D projection. At its center is a projector that generates an energy field simulating a physical body and gravity well so convincingly that our sensors mistook it for an actual planet, producing the anomalous data. We can only speculate as to why someone would go to the trouble of faking the presence of a planetary body at this location. Sadly the projector did not survive our experimentation.
